brief: Holds the connection state shared by the library's network clients: the last request, the last error and the timeout.
detail: It is the base of stzHttpClient, stzTcpClient, stzTcpServer and stzWebSocket and keeps no socket itself. Its state is plain attributes: the address and status of the last recorded request, the last error text and code, and a timeout in seconds. The engine HTTP client is request-scoped, so IsConnected only says that a request has run. Subclasses override IsConnected to report an open socket. The class makes no request by itself.
